name: VHIS Website — working design tokens
status: Proposed for management review; not approved brand guidance
source: VHIS logo supplied at https://res.cloudinary.com/diiwcoarc/image/upload/v1787580561/logo2_yeaior.png and saved locally as assets/vhis-logo.png

color/primary.description: Sampled VHIS logo crimson. Primary actions and institutional emphasis.

color/primary-dark.description: Sampled deep burgundy from the VHIS crest; deep backgrounds.

color/primary-light.description: Light supporting tint derived from logo crimson.

color/secondary.description: Deep burgundy supporting brand emphasis, derived from the crest.

color/accent.description: Sampled warm gold-orange detail from the VHIS logo tagline.

color/background.description: Warm neutral page background paired with the logo.

color/surface.description: Provisional light card and form surface.

color/text-secondary.description: Secondary text on light surfaces, selected for WCAG AA contrast on light backgrounds.

color/success.description: Success feedback; validate context contrast before use.

color/warning.description: Warning feedback; validate context contrast before use.

color/error.description: Error feedback; validate context contrast before use.

color/on-primary.description: Text and icon color on primary surfaces.

color/focus.description: Dark warm focus indicator; use a 3 px outline and offset. Validate on final surfaces.

font/display.description: Proposed family for display and heading text.

font/body.description: Proposed family for body text, labels, controls and navigation.

type/h1.description: Page title; responsive clamp down to 40px.

type/h2.description: Section heading; responsive clamp down to 32px.

type/caption.description: Captions, dates and metadata; not for essential copy.
